programme.desc: The Aeolian Islands. Jamie begins his Italian adventure in the awe-inspiring Aeolian Islands. He cooks a delicious chicken and eggplant pot roast with lemony couscous. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Jamie Cooks Italy
programme.desc: Puglia. Jamie travels to Puglia to find the family recipes that make this region the hottest food destination in Italy. Plus, he cooks homemade pasta with broccoli and tangy pesto. S1, Ep2

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Jeffrey's Birthday Pop-Up. Ina throws Jeffrey a surprise birthday party. On the menu for the celebration is a Greek platter, spinach pie and a delicious raspberry and orange trifle. S6, Ep7

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back To Basics
programme.desc: Brunch Bunch. Ina enlists the help of a local florist and photographer to create the perfect brunch setup. In the kitchen, she makes baked blintzes with fresh blueberry sauce. S6, Ep8

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Desserts. It's round three, and the heat in the kitchen is rising with a burglary in the Bake Off tent, as the remaining 11 bakers get ready to deal with desserts. S4, Ep3

programme.title: The Great British Bake-Off
programme.desc: Pies & Tarts. It's the fourth round and the baking is getting serious as the remaining bakers don their pinnies to pimp up pies and tarts. They must create an age-old custard tart. S4, Ep4

programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes
programme.desc: Munich. Paul Hollywood is in Munich to discover traditional German baking. He learns the secret behind Munich's pretzels, he tries Baumkuchen and makes a dampfnudel dessert. S1, Ep10

programme.title: Paul Hollywood City Bakes
programme.desc: Best Of Bakes. From babka and Caprese cake to empanada pie and cheesecake brownie, Paul Hollywood looks back over some of his favourite City Bakes he created on his visits. S1, Ep11

programme.title: Jamie Oliver: Cooking For Less
programme.desc: With the rising cost of food and energy, Jamie Oliver is on a mission to make delicious dishes that won't break the budget. S1, Ep1

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Hometown Inspiration. Guy Fieri heads to Portland, Oregon, to visit a spot putting a vegan spin on Israeli flavours. Plus, Louisiana specialities are on the menu in Logan, Utah. S31, Ep11

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins, And Dives
programme.desc: Beef, Lamb And Pig. Guy Fieri hunts down meaty favourites in Kentucky and North Carolina. He enjoys an Irish pub's cottage pie, Asian-barbecue fusion and pimento-topped burgers. S26, Ep5
